title.narrative: Trust Fund for Consultative Group to Assist the Poorest (CGAP)

description.narrative: CGAP will fund a few networks to work with interested partners, to develop and test out possible indicators for tracking client level changes. CGAP will work with the networks to ensure consensus on one common reporting format for the industry, i.e. one indicator for each MDG to ensure comparisons across institutions. $180,000 will be used for grants and $60,000 for consultants.
